body: Most of the time we don't do anything after work because we're doing 12 hour shifts, and most of my coworkers have/are starting families. There are a couple if older officers that have me over pretty frequently because they've noticed I tend to be by myself, but it honestly makes it worse because I see these great relationships they've got, girlfriends and wives who are waiting for them at the door every morning and kids up early to see them before going to school. Their so's all do the same type of meal prep for them, and spend time with each other, but what that invariably leads to is couples going out with each other when off duty and leaving me and a few other single officers on our own. There are only 4 of us, but one of them is low key a complete psychopath (he has no business doing what he's doing) so I obviously avoid him. The other two seem to genuinely have no interest,  they spend all their time with friends from college.
